about.title: A software house built on clarity.
about.body1: Apptivity (apptivity.id) is an Indonesian software house under PT Lawson Semesta Indonesia. We build web and mobile apps for professionals, SMEs, government agencies, and companies.
about.body2: Sahabat means partner, not just a buyer. We give our best advice and alternatives for your needs — with zero pressure to buy. When you need professionals, we're ready to deliver.

why.body: Because you always know what you pay for, when it finishes, and what you get. Every project is officially recorded by a legal company. If results miss the agreement, your money comes back.

cases.problem: Three schools in Padang Panjang (Kartika 1–5, Pertiwi 1, SMKN 2) struggled with piles of new-student registrations every school year.
cases.solution: We built a shared online admission system and online report cards.

cases.problem: Stock of goods and medicine at several institutions was still logged manually — discrepancies surfaced late.
cases.solution: We built FIFO-based inventory systems for warehouses, a supermarket, and health centers.
cases.result: Neat per-batch stock records. Expiring goods easier to monitor.

items.a: apptivity.id is an Indonesian software house under PT Lawson Semesta Indonesia. We build web and mobile apps with clear pricing, open progress, and a money-back guarantee. We call our clients Sahabat — partners, not just buyers.

It depends on scope. Every project starts from Rp500 thousand — see Price Estimates on this page. Final pricing is set after a free consultation, then written down before we start. Payments follow milestones: 30% DP, 40% progress, 30% handover.
Landing pages typically take 2–4 weeks, web apps 1–3 months, mobile apps 2–4 months. The exact timeline is written in the contract before work begins.

We work with PHP/Laravel, Next.js/React, React Native/Expo, and Flutter — with Oracle, MySQL, or PostgreSQL databases, plus AI and WhatsApp API integrations. The final stack follows your project needs. See the full list in Proof & Reviews.

items.q: Buy or rent — which fits me?
items.a: Choose Buy if you want to own and change the app anytime, with no charges after close. Choose Rent for light upfront cost: small additions free, built-in server and domain free, just a yearly fee. Both include free consultation for clients and Primary Affiliator registration.
On the Buy scheme, the source code is yours and fully handed over on final payment. On the Rent scheme, the app stays managed by Apptivity during the rental period.
Four steps: free consultation with no obligation, a written agreement in a contract, regularly reported progress until done, and a money-back guarantee if results miss the agreement.

items.q: What if results don't match the agreement?
items.a: We refund the value of the features that miss the agreement. Conversely, out-of-scope requests are discussed openly from the start.

items.q: Is there support after the project ends?
items.a: Yes. Apptivity clients get free consultation. Fixes within the 30-day warranty after handover are free. New features are discussed openly.
Yes. We operate under PT Lawson Semesta Indonesia (single-shareholder company). Every transaction is recorded and taxes reported.

items.q: How do I start a project?
items.a: Chat our WhatsApp or Instagram DM — free, replied within 7 hours. Or fill the 3-step form on this page; your brief goes straight to our WhatsApp.
